name: B10-0358/2026 (Verts/ALE) – The threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for action on the crisis in El-Obeid, Sudan, where fighting has displaced over 13 million people and drone strikes have cut water, power and hospitals. It asks European Union countries to push for a ceasefire, lift the siege, protect civilians and open humanitarian aid routes. It also urges sanctions on those committing abuses and on outside states, especially the United Arab Emirates, that arm and fund the fighters. This is a statement of demands, not a change in law.

- The Parliament demands a ceasefire, aid access and civilian protection in El-Obeid; it affects Sudan's civilians and warring parties.
- It urges sanctions and a wider arms embargo; this affects the United Arab Emirates and other backers of the Rapid Support Forces.
- European Union countries and diplomats must now act on these calls; no legal change follows automatically.
